caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware jug centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The jug has a cylindrical body with a rounded shoulder that tapers into a short, narrow neck and an outwardly flaring rim. The jug is predominantly rendered in shades of brown, with a horizontal grayish-blue band encircling the middle. The highlights and shading on the jug suggest a light source coming from the left, creating areas of lighter brown and slight shadow on the right side. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the drawing. The artist’s initials “M.A.R.S.” appear in red in the lower right corner, with a small red star above them. Handwritten notations are faintly visible at the top of the page.
title: Stone Fruit Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
